text:
sam: FYI — a bunch of onboarding sample apps started failing right after the 1.4.0 SDK publish. Seen on Cloudflare & Vercel edge runtimes.

sam: Error from a user's repro: `TypeError: fetch is not a function` thrown inside our auth retry wrapper.

ashley: ugh. Did we accidentally ship only the ESM entry for edge consumers? I remember we flipped `exports` to prefer `import` earlier today.

jin: yep — looking at the tarball, package.json now has `exports` with only an `import` target pointing at `dist/index.mjs`. Node CJS consumers (and some bundlers) end up hitting the fallback which doesn't include our `lib/auth` shim. Edge runtimes that polyfill fetch get a different codepath.

oliver: repro steps I ran: `npx create-redwood-sample && npm i @redwood/inference-js@1.4.0 && node ./sample.js` — works locally on Node 18 (CJS) when I force `require('.../dist/index.cjs')` but fails in Cloudflare worker sandbox.

sam: also noticed TS complaints in sample-apps CI: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference-js'`. Looks like types aren't reachable through the new exports map.

ashley: ok priorities: (1) stop breaking edge runtimes/auth retry, (2) fix types for TS consumers, (3) make exports deterministic across edge/node.

jin: quick mitigation — patch package.json to include conditional exports for both `import` and `require`, and add a top-level `types` field. something like:

```
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": "./dist/index.mjs",
    "require": "./dist/index.cjs",
    "default": "./dist/index.cjs"
  },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"main": "dist/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts"
```

ashley: adding `./package.json` export helps some bundlers/pack tools. adding explicit `require` target should route old consumers to CJS and keep edge runtimes using ESM.

oliver: also double-check that our auth/retry uses a runtime-safe `fetch` guard — we currently `if (typeof fetch !== 'function') throw` which is wrong for Vercel edge polyfills. Suggest wrapping with a small runtime adapter: `const _fetch = globalThis.fetch || require('node-fetch');` but keep it lazy.

sam: agree. Also types: our `dist/index.d.ts` gets omitted by the exports map; adding `types` should fix `Could not find a declaration file` for most TS setups. For stricter setups we might need `typesVersions` or `package.exports` typings mapping.

jin: I pushed a quick branch with package.json revert + type field and added a tiny `fetchAdapter` that falls back only when `globalThis.fetch` is missing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/312 (draft).

deploy-bot: CI started for branch fix/exportmap-1.4.1 — build 482 failed on lint (line-length in adapter).

ashley: lint fix incoming, but are we comfortable releasing a patch that reintroduces explicit exports for both entry points? I'm thinking yes — this is regressing too many onboarding flows.

oliver: yes. Also add a short note in the release notes: "Fix: restore CJS entry + types mapping to avoid edge/runtime and TS breakages introduced in 1.4.0". We should also include a brief guide in the devex samples on how to import in edge vs node.

sam: I'll update sample apps to pin 1.4.1 once merged and add a CI job that runs our smoke repro on Cloudflare Workers (lightweight) to catch this next time.

jin: CI green after lint fix. merging PR and cutting 1.4.1.

sam: confirmed with ahem-users that their Vercel preview now loads. will monitor error rates for auth retries. thanks y'all :rocket:
